changes: Scope wording distinguishes discussion scope, completed methods, and pending judgments while preserving meaningful exceptions.
Introduction connects existing knowledge, reader difficulty, and the usefulness of the organizing view; navigation explains transitions and does not stand in for the reading reason.
Conclusion explains relationships, limits, tradeoffs, and conditional uses; it may restate framework/tutorial/practice value without inventing findings or a future-work list.
Abstract selects information needed for independent understanding and need not carry every finding, limitation, or conclusion agenda.
Useful repetition remains allowed when it serves the current part; identical lists cannot merely be relabeled as compression, navigation, and synthesis.
Stage-specific duty prompts now carry the selected introduction, conclusion, and abstract actions at generation time, not only in the conception card.

prompt_excerpt.abstract: 从实际正文选择足以理解本文对象、组织价值和核心认识的信息，保留决定判断含义的条件。
